name: web-orange-fashion-hero-with-melted-figure-and-white-frame
title: Orange gradient hero with a white frame, giant black 'THE TRENDS WE WEAR', a profile portrait and melting reflection
whatItIs: An orange gradient poster with a liquid-distorted red reflection of a head above and below a white rectangle containing a thin nav, a giant heavy black 'THE TRENDS WE WEAR' and a photo of a man in profile looking up with a flourished white serif logo 'Avara' and tiny corner captions.
whatItMeans: Bold and warm; the melting reflection adds surreal energy to a clean layout.
techniques: Frame a page as a white rectangle over a vivid field.
Extend the subject as a distorted reflection.
Set giant heavy caps as a headline.
Overlay a serif logo on the photo.

vocabulary.definition: A warped melting effect on an image.
A white panel holding UI over a colour field.
A serif wordmark placed over a photo.
